revisions.reason: 2026-11-23 mouse movement payload: handleMouseMove snapshots existing physical Ctrl/Shift state with nonmutating peekKeyDownState and combines it with held mouse buttons for ordinary, cached-child, captured queued and captured synchronous WM_MOUSEMOVE dispatch. No new callback, guest entry, timer, continuation, retained reference or invocation ownership. Existing routing, coordinates, capture resolution, dispatch order and coalescing predicate are preserved; differing modifier masks now form the intended coalescing barrier. NEW test-renderer-mouse-move-modifiers.cjs independently checks documented masks across 271 cases, including sided modifiers and native EDIT early returns. Unchanged drag test passes; both untracked TrackMouseEvent originals retain their independently observed baseline failures. Broader invocation ownership remains pending.
